description: This source file defines a set of functions in CMake scripting for building JSON structures, including callbacks for JSON object and array delimiters, key-value pairs, literals, and delegate JSON functions.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Main function that initializes the JSON building context, sets up callbacks, and delegates JSON processing based on provided arguments.

methods.name: json_obj_begin
methods.description: Callback function to start a JSON object, appends '{' to the current context string.

methods.name: json_obj_end
methods.description: Callback function to end a JSON object, appends '}' to the current context string.

methods.name: json_array_begin
methods.description: Callback function to start a JSON array, appends '[' to the current context string.

methods.name: json_array_end
methods.description: Callback function to end a JSON array, appends ']' to the current context string.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_begin
methods.description: Callback to begin a key-value pair in a JSON object, converts key to JSON string and appends 'key:' to context.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_end
methods.description: Callback to end a key-value pair, appends a comma if more elements follow.

methods.name: json_array_element_end
methods.description: Callback to end an array element, appends a comma if more elements follow.

methods.name: json_literal
methods.description: Handles JSON literals such as null, true, false, numbers, and strings, appending them to the current context.
